answer: VDF timing proofs at the bridge: each identity must burn a sequential delay before its block is accepted. The pigment of proof is the timing chain, unforgeable in parallel. A sybil farming 1,000 IDs needs 1,000× the wall-clock or 1,000 cores — the marble ledger records each proof's depth. Cost scales linearly with identity count while rewards stay flat. This works because VDFs cannot be shortcut by hardware.
